additionalRequirements.condition: candidate-v1.json schemaVersion 2 validates against candidate.schema.json and validate-candidate.mjs passes all cross-field assertions before every simulation run.
active, standard and passive day schedules are ordered and each totals exactly 86400 seconds; the first-ten continuous schedule is separate.
all three builds use the same paired holdout seeds 100000-100999, keyed order-independent PRNG draws, and a manifest-defined distribution mapping.

the abstract 100F model defines 12 cats, 10 districts and bosses, all shop unlock floors, support activations, X9 relic effects, armament tiers and the four-phase F100 override without authorizing 11F runtime production.

combat uses individual actor HP, exact wave and threat allocation, targeting, projectile and heavy cadence, skills, helpers, recovery and every atomic one-hit rejection class; the simulator may not use pooled HP for pass/fail.

initial state, purchase candidates, reserve, utility, tie order, effect composition, shop duplicate and adjacency rules, retries, limits and non-finite handling are executable without invented values.
Dawn uses 33 exact reward IDs totaling at most 43 shards, one claimed set and atomic set-difference commit; a zero-gain recovery Dawn never increments rewardingDawnCount or increases U.
offline U is role-neutral and nondecreasing, settlement is idempotent, commerce composition is capped, known re-clear time/reward/boundaries are exact, and all three repeated-cycle tests are defined.
D10_pre and Net10 use the declared structural probe, exact entry/coin-only/total states and one scalar effective-power definition; any undefined or non-finite probe fails.
a new round of three independent critics reports no unresolved P0 or P1 blocker, all machine checks pass, and no runtime or asset file changes are present.

failureConditions: any day schedule differs from 86400 seconds
a build receives a different holdout seed set
an ID used by machine state is absent from the stable registry
a formula ID lacks declared operands
F1 does not contain one tutorial enemy or F100 does not contain four phases
U decreases after legitimate floor or rewarding-Dawn progress
an atomic one-hit class is omitted
a critic must invent a numeric or state rule to implement Step 2
